description: Ministry of Mass Media - Rule made under Section 45 (Chapter 190) of the Post Office Ordinance Money Orders issued with effect from 01.01.2019 to 31.12.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification contains rules and regulations regarding the validity, refund procedures, and expiration policies for Money Orders issued by the Post Office. It is made under statutory authority (Section 45 of the Post Office Ordinance) and establishes legal procedures and compliance requirements for financial instruments, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. While it mentions a State Minister's name in the signature, this is purely procedural and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
